method: Workspace images render existing Plasma React components with synthetic data. The connection-setup image is a fresh capture of the actual running Electron application. See per-file provenance below.

connection-setup-light.webp.method: Built the application with electron-vite and launched its actual main/preload/renderer bundles with an isolated temporary userData and sessionData profile using the app's light theme. Captured the real dialog with Electron webContents.capturePage at 2x resolution; no recoloring, reconstructed UI or uploaded image was used.
connection-setup-light.webp.data: Light-mode New connection dialog. Example values entered through the app: Local storefront, 127.0.0.1, storefront, developer. Password left empty; visible bullets are the app's placeholder. No database connection was made and no existing user profile was accessed.
connection-setup-light.webp.encoding: WebP quality 94 from a 1152 x 1532 PNG capture of the actual dialog.

postgres.webp.data: Illustrative commerce schema, orders and customers. Timings are example UI values, not performance claims.

redis.webp.data: Illustrative session hash, namespace keys and TTL.

opensearch.webp.data: Illustrative commerce event index, mappings and documents.

explain.webp.data: Illustrative PostgreSQL JSON plan supplied to the actual EXPLAIN inspector. This is not a benchmark.

social_preview: ../og.png combines the full Plasma wordmark, hero copy and the actual-app connection-setup-light.webp capture.
encoding: Component captures use WebP quality 92 at device scale factor 1.25 and are labeled as illustrative. The actual-app dialog capture has its own encoding record above.
